author: Cezbla
body:
KOTL as you know is a game where there is a big ladder one block and you go up the top and stay there for 30 seconds or less, I have added a mix to this and changed it to a bigger ladder but it has some misssing ladders on the way up which will challange the player to the max.


I think this would be a awesome gamemode for avicade thank you and now enjoy the pictures! [There was some photo bombing from one of the creators creamy dohnut 99 excuse his actions LOL!]


Best regards,

World: I will send it over skype to who ever wants to see it map devs of corse! thank you!
